# AusPak

AusPak helps a cricket analyst or fan explore how Australia and Pakistan
score runs and lose wickets across the phases of a men's One Day
International (ODI) innings. It ships per-over scoring data for the 45
Australia v Pakistan ODIs in the Cricsheet archive, a function that
summarises scoring by phase of the innings, and a Shiny app for exploring
the results.

**Question the app answers:** in which part of an ODI innings does each side
score fastest and lose wickets, and has that changed over time?

Documentation website: <https://etc5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-somya090997/>

## Installation

```r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("ETC5523-2026/etc5523-assignment-4-somya090997")
```

## Launch the app

```r
library(AusPak)
run_app()
```

The app lets you choose the innings (batting first or chasing), a measure
(runs or wickets per over), whether to view phases or individual overs, and
a range of years. A second tab explains the fields and how to read the
results.

## Where the data comes from

Ball-by-ball records from [Cricsheet](https://cricsheet.org), downloaded with
the cricketdata package. The script `data-raw/odi-overs.R` keeps every men's
ODI in which Australia and Pakistan played each other, drops super overs, and
summarises each innings over by over.

## What is in `aus_pak_overs`


| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `match_id` | Cricsheet match identifier |
| `date` | Date the match started |
| `venue` | Ground |
| `innings` | 1 (batting first) or 2 (chasing) |
| `batting_team` | Team batting in that innings |
| `over` | Over number, from 1 |
| `over_runs` | Runs in the over, including extras |
| `over_wickets` | Wickets in the over, all dismissal types |
| `score`, `wickets` | Running totals at the end of the over |
